goal: Create a memorable, premium first-visit experience inspired by scientific monitoring systems and cinematic game boot screens, while keeping the product professional, accessible and fast.

design.branding: Use Elanco branding/logo; do not invent a separate product brand or logo.
visuals: stylised outline of the United Kingdom gradually appearing
blue sighting points illuminating on the map
subtle connecting lines and restrained HUD-style details
design.main_dashboard: Transition into the existing clean, light Elanco-branded dashboard.

sequence.name: Initialisation
sequence.visual: Dark navy screen; subtle power-on visual; Elanco logo appears.

sequence.name: Data connection
sequence.visual: Scanning line and restrained data particles.

sequence.name: Map visualisation
sequence.visual: UK outline materialises; map points illuminate.

sequence.name: Data preparation
sequence.visual: Map completes its reveal; subtle synchronisation animation.

sequence.name: Ready
sequence.visual: Brief confirmation; map expands/transitions into dashboard.

timing.skip: Always provide an immediately available Skip button.
timing.returning_visit: Show a shortened transition or skip the full intro.
timing.loading: Do not fake progress or claim API success. If real loading is required, reflect actual application readiness.

audio.autoplay: Never play audio without explicit user interaction.
audio.failure: Audio failure must not block or affect the intro or dashboard.

accessibility_and_performance.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion and provide a simplified/static transition.
accessibility_and_performance.mobile: Use a shorter, lightweight version on mobile.
accessibility_and_performance.keyboard: Skip and sound controls must be keyboard accessible and visibly focusable.
accessibility_and_performance.performance: Avoid large assets and expensive effects; lazy-load optional audio/assets where appropriate.
accessibility_and_performance.failure: If intro assets or animations fail, render the dashboard normally.

implementation.audio: Howler.js or lightweight Web Audio implementation
implementation.architecture: Keep the intro isolated in a reusable component; do not modify backend functionality.
implementation.state: Use session-based display logic so the full intro is not repeatedly shown during the same browsing session.

acceptance_criteria: The intro looks like a professional scientific monitoring system, not an arcade game.
The full sequence takes no more than 7 seconds under normal conditions.
Audio is muted until the user enables it.
The intro does not claim that external data has synchronised unless the backend confirms it.
The dashboard remains usable if animation or audio fails.
The experience works on desktop and mobile.
agent_instructions: Inspect the existing project structure and design before implementing.
Reuse existing dependencies and components where practical; do not install packages unnecessarily.
Do not replace or redesign the main dashboard.
Do not invent Elanco brand guidelines; use the project's established palette and assets.
Implement the feature, run available checks, and report changed files and any setup steps.
